description: React component for managing cluster settings in Mattermost admin console, including high availability configuration, cluster name, hostname override, gossip protocol settings, and related warnings.

classes.name: ClusterSettings
classes.description: React component extending OLDAdminSettings, managing cluster configuration settings including high availability, cluster name, hostname override, gossip protocol options, and related warnings.

methods.name: getConfigFromState
methods.description: Constructs and returns an AdminConfig object based on the current component state.

methods.name: getStateFromConfig
methods.description: Initializes component state from the provided AdminConfig object.

methods.name: renderTitle
methods.description: Renders the title of the settings section using formatted message.

methods.name: overrideHandleChange
methods.description: Handles change events for settings, sets warning state, and calls generic handleChange.

methods.name: renderSettings
methods.description: Renders the cluster settings form, including warnings, configuration options, and conditional display based on license and cluster ID.
